subject.title: docs: note LanceDB dreaming v0.2.3 via memory-lancedb-dreaming plugin

question: Should OpenClaw core docs include a generic LanceDB/vector-native Dreaming caveat, or should this package/version availability stay entirely on ClawHub?
rationale: VISION.md supports documenting core extension points but routes plugin promotion and live package metadata to ClawHub, so automation should not choose the docs policy alone.

options.title: Land generic docs wording
options.body: Keep package names, release versions, install hooks, and endorsement out of core docs, but document the slot-owner config rule and point users to ClawHub for community vector-native Dreaming plugins.

options.title: Keep this entirely on ClawHub
options.body: Close the linked docs PR and leave the package/version listing, install hints, release history, and security status to ClawHub package pages.

recommendation.title: Land generic docs wording
recommendation.body: Keep package names, release versions, install hooks, and endorsement out of core docs, but document the slot-owner config rule and point users to ClawHub for community vector-native Dreaming plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The current decision is primarily core docs scope, and this person authored the central Dreaming docs rewrite.
